# Plan: Sort `extra/567/` files into real project folders + build the MOC dashboards

## Context

`extra/567/` is a flat dump of ~110 notes. The vault has three real project folders at
its root, each holding a near-empty MOC stub marked with the identifier `01309298993`:

| Folder | Real MOC file | Project |
|---|---|---|
| `01_homolog_oc/` | `01_homolog_oc_moc.md` | Genome-wide metallothionein homolog ID in *Oryza coarctata* (dry lab) |
| `02_knocout_os/` | `02_knocout_os_moc.md` | CRISPR / transgenic *OCMT* knockout confirmation in *O. sativa* (BRRI Dhan67 / BR67) |
| `03_adenocarcenoma_single_cell/` | `03_adenocarcenoma_single_cell_moc.md` | Adenocarcinoma / pediatric-tumour single-cell analysis (cancer, not plant) |

**How to find "the real MOC":** the identifier is a grep tag. From the vault root:
`grep -rl "01309298993" .` → the three `*_moc.md` files above (it also appears in
`extra/567/SENSITIVE_Master-Password-List.md`, which is an unrelated coincidence and is
left alone). In Obsidian, global-search `01309298993` does the same.

Goal: move only the notes that **clearly** belong to one of these three projects into its
folder, rename them to a consistent scheme, repoint their links, and rewrite the three
MOCs as hand-curated dashboards so each project can be understood from its MOC alone.

## Decisions locked with the user

- Only sort into the **three folders that exist**. Molecular-dynamics and *plant*
  single-cell notes have no folder → they stay in `extra/567/`.
- The old scaffold MOCs in 567 (`01_OC_homolog MOC.md`, `02_OS_Knockout MOC.md`,
  `03_Molecular_Dynamics_of_OC MOC.md`, `04_SC_of_metallothionein MOC.md`, `MOC.md`,
  `SC MOC.md`) are **left untouched**; the real MOCs are built fresh.
- Filename scheme for moved files: **`NN_slug_description.md`** (lowercase, underscores),
  e.g. `01_homolog_oc_homolog_finder_protocol.md`.
- **Move only clear matches.** Borderline notes stay in 567 (listed at the end for the
  user to pull in later if wanted).
- Non-project files (templates, `t-*`, dashboards, area notes, daily notes, coursework,
  `SENSITIVE_*`, reagent zettels, manuscript layer) stay in 567.

## Moves + renames

### → `01_homolog_oc/` (9 files)

| From (`extra/567/`) | To (`01_homolog_oc/`) |
|---|---|
| `Homolog Finder of ocoarctaata.md` | `01_homolog_oc_homolog_finder_protocol.md` |
| `ORIGINAL_backup_Homolog Finder of ocoarctaata.md` | `01_homolog_oc_homolog_finder_protocol_original_backup.md` |
| `Reanalysis of homolog finding.md` | `01_homolog_oc_homolog_reanalysis_pipeline.md` |
| `P001-E001_draft_homolog-pipeline.md` | `01_homolog_oc_homolog_pipeline_draft.md` |
| `P001-E001_log_2026-08-04.md` | `01_homolog_oc_log_2026-08-04.md` |
| `Protocol lineage.md` | `01_homolog_oc_protocol_lineage.md` |
| `Genome wide homology of Metallothionein.md` | `01_homolog_oc_genome_wide_homology_notes.md` |
| `Homolog finder Bash Script.md` | `01_homolog_oc_homolog_finder_bash_script.md` |
| `Homolog finder in OC proteome.md` | `01_homolog_oc_homolog_finder_in_oc_proteome.md` |

### → `02_knocout_os/` (4 files)

| From (`extra/567/`) | To (`02_knocout_os/`) |
|---|---|
| `CTAB genomic DNA extraction.md` | `02_knocout_os_ctab_dna_extraction_protocol.md` |
| `OS-E001_PCR-MT-confirmation-T3.md` | `02_knocout_os_e001_pcr_mt_confirmation_t3.md` |
| `OsU3 vs OsU6(Better) promoter (rice genome editing).md` | `02_knocout_os_osu3_vs_osu6_promoter.md` |
| `BR67_MT_Plant-Lines_Registry.md` *(medium confidence)* | `02_knocout_os_br67_mt_plant_lines_registry.md` |

### → `03_adenocarcenoma_single_cell/` (3 files — all medium confidence)

| From (`extra/567/`) | To (`03_adenocarcenoma_single_cell/`) |
|---|---|
| `STAR Method.md` | `03_adenocarcenoma_single_cell_star_methods_template.md` |
| `c2 sc.md` | `03_adenocarcenoma_single_cell_integration_diagram.excalidraw.md` |
| `neuroblastoma.md` | `03_adenocarcenoma_single_cell_neuroblastoma_notes.md` |

Flagged files: veto any before I run. Rationale for 03: all three are cancer / pediatric-tumour
single-cell (STAR Methods sheet cites "pediatric patient tumor tissue, UZ Ghent"; the
excalidraw covers scVI integration / batch effects / biomarker–drug-target; neuroblastoma
is a pediatric cancer). `Oishi Speech.md` (ACE2 / blood pressure) is *not* moved.

## Link + frontmatter fixes (after moving)

1. **Frontmatter `project:`** on every moved file → repointed to the real MOC
   (`[[01_homolog_oc_moc]]`, `[[02_knocout_os_moc]]`, `[[03_adenocarcenoma_single_cell_moc]]`),
   replacing stale values like `[[01_OC_homolog MOC]]` / `[[P001_OcMT-family-characterisation]]`.
   Add a minimal `type:` / `project:` block to the files that currently have none
   (`Homolog finder Bash Script.md`, `Homolog finder in OC proteome.md`, `neuroblastoma.md`,
   `Protocol lineage.md`).

2. **Wikilink rewrites** (rename breaks name-based `[[links]]`). Vault-wide, rewrite the
   16 old basenames → new basenames, preserving `|aliases` and `#anchors`. Known
   inbound links to fix, in files that stay put:
   - `extra/567/2026-08-20.md` → `[[CTAB genomic DNA extraction]]`, `[[OS-E001_PCR-MT-confirmation-T3]]`
   - `extra/567/CTAB.md`, `PCI.md`, `Sodium acetate.md`, `β-mercaptoethanol.md` → `[[CTAB genomic DNA extraction]]`
   - `extra/567/BR67_Functional-Genomics-Plant.md` → `[[BR67_MT_Plant-Lines_Registry]]`
   - `extra/567/work-ledger.md` → `[[c2 sc]]`
   - plus cross-links among the moved files (`Protocol lineage`, `Reanalysis…`,
     `CTAB genomic DNA extraction`, `OS-E001…`, `STAR Method`→`neuroblastoma`).
   - `extra/567/02_OS_Knockout MOC.md` also links `[[OsU3 vs OsU6…]]`; it is an
     "untouched" scaffold, so this one link is updated in place too (harmless, keeps the
     vault free of dead links) unless you'd rather leave it dangling.

## Rebuild the three MOCs (fresh)

Each real `*_moc.md` is rewritten to this shape, keeping the bare `01309298993` line so
the grep tag still works:

```
---
type: moc
project: <folder name>
moc_id: 01309298993
status: active
---
# <Project title> — Map of Content

01309298993

> [!info] Scope
> <one-paragraph scope>

## Start here
- <2-3 most important notes, with one-line descriptions>

## <grouped sections: Protocols / Pipeline / Experiments / Logs / Scripts / Registries / Provenance>
- <every moved file, wikilinked, one line each>

## Everything in this project (auto)
​```dataview
TABLE type AS Type, status AS Status, file.mtime AS Touched
FROM "<folder name>"
WHERE file.name != this.file.name
SORT file.mtime DESC
​```
```

- **01** groups: Start here (finder protocol, reanalysis pipeline) · Pipeline & drafts ·
  Logs · Scripts · Provenance (`protocol_lineage`).
- **02** keeps its existing *Experimental design* embed and *Experiment line-up* list,
  then adds: Protocols (CTAB) · Experiments (E001 PCR) · Line registries (BR67 MT lines +
  the existing `OCMT Transgenic Line Registry (BRRI Dhan67)`) · Design refs (OsU3 vs OsU6).
- **03** groups: Methods (STAR sheet) · Diagrams (integration excalidraw) · Disease notes
  (neuroblastoma). Scope callout notes this is the cancer single-cell arm.

## Not moved — borderline, left in `extra/567/` (pull in later if you want)

`Bansal 2020.md`, `Thesis plan.md`, `P001-E004_seed-germination-BR75-BR81.md`,
`P001-E004_log_2026-08-06.md`, `Seed pictures in 14 th MS media.md`,
`BR67_Functional-Genomics-Plant.md`, `BR67_PVA-ASR_Transgenic-Lines.md`,
`BR67 Plant Data.md`, `Funcitional Analysis of Metallothionein Gene in Rice.md`,
`DNa extraction.md`, `Wang et al., 2021.md`, `Liu et al., 2021.md`, `Oishi Speech.md`,
`Usman et al 2025.md`, and the plant-single-cell set (`Ortholog projection strategy.md`,
`Oryza coarctata data inventory.md`, `Oryza sativa scRNA-seq datasets.md`,
`Plant single-cell atlas databases.md`).

## Verification

1. `ls 01_homolog_oc 02_knocout_os 03_adenocarcenoma_single_cell` → new files present,
   names follow `NN_slug_description.md`.
2. `grep -rl "01309298993" .` → still the three `*_moc.md` (unchanged tag).
3. `grep -rn "\[\[Homolog Finder of ocoarctaata\|\[\[CTAB genomic DNA extraction\|\[\[OS-E001\|\[\[Reanalysis of homolog finding\|\[\[Protocol lineage\|\[\[c2 sc\|\[\[neuroblastoma\|\[\[BR67_MT_Plant-Lines_Registry\|\[\[OsU3 vs OsU6" .`
   → no stale references outside the untouched 567 scaffolds.
4. Open each MOC in Obsidian: curated links resolve (no dead-link underlines), the
   dataview table lists the moved files.
5. `git status` → only the intended moves/renames/edits; nothing under `.obsidian/`.
